text: {"features":[{"name":"Software engineering depth","description":"How much substantial professional experience the letter shows in testing, maintaining, and launching production software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only the lower end of the sample on production experience, with limited time in role or a narrow set of systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows enough production experience to meet the role, but with either limited years, limited service breadth, or lightly described scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level experience across several years and several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production experience through many years or a broad track record across multiple services with clear operational maturity."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially deep production experience through both extensive years and repeated responsibility for launching and maintaining multiple services."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"How strong the letter's formal academic background is for a software security engineering role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States only a qualifying bachelor's degree."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a relevant bachelor's degree and presents it as purposeful technical preparation for the role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a relevant master's degree."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"States a relevant doctoral degree."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"States a relevant doctoral degree and uses it to reinforce unusually advanced technical preparation in the rest of the letter."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates depth of professional Go experience relevant to back-end systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go as one language among others, with limited indication that it is a core language."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some regular Go use in production, but not clearly as the main language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows Go as a primary working language for production software."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Go as the main language across several years, services, or major back-end systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows long-running, central Go ownership that strongly matches a Go back-end role."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates depth of professional Python use relevant to tooling, automation, or services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it too vaguely to judge."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python as a secondary tool, but without clear evidence of regular production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for services, automation, or internal tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production Python experience across multiple use cases such as services, tooling, tests, or analysis."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a deeply trusted working language, with evidence of production-grade practices or especially heavy role-relevant use."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How much concrete experience the letter shows in evaluating systems for security risks and validating remediation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no concrete evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security reviews or attacker thinking only in general terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes recognizable assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or validation of fixes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated, structured assessment work across different systems or development stages."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep, methodical assessment practice with clear techniques, scope, and follow-through on remediation."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or handling workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention vulnerability handling or triage work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security automation broadly, but not concrete vulnerability intake or triage work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes some involvement in classifying, routing, deduplicating, or otherwise processing vulnerability reports."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows ownership of vulnerability-handling automation that materially reduces manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows high-leverage, end-to-end vulnerability automation with clear operational improvements in workflow, throughput, or response capacity."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"How much concrete experience the letter shows in designing agent-based systems with meaningful control and safety boundaries.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not describe any agentic systems experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to agents or AI automation in vague terms without architecture or control details."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic tooling with identifiable agent and back-end components."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains how agents and services were designed together with explicit constraints, permissions, or auditability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated end-to-end agentic architecture focused on safe autonomy, clear contracts, and operational control."}]},{"name":"Applied AI maturity","description":"How convincingly the letter shows hands-on experience using AI in production settings where reliability matters.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention AI experience or mentions AI only as future interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI exposure, but not concrete implementation or production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building or shipping AI or LLM functionality."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes production AI work together with evaluation, reliability, guardrails, or trustworthiness concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially mature applied AI experience where dependable operation in real workflows is central to the story."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic strength","description":"How much practical command of data structures and algorithms the letter demonstrates.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of data-structure or algorithmic ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength, but offers no concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one clear example of using a data structure or algorithm to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical algorithmic reasoning applied to a meaningful bottleneck or core system behavior."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially strong algorithmic command through sophisticated, high-impact problem solving that is clearly described."}]},{"name":"Ownership level","description":"How clearly the letter shows the applicant personally drove relevant technical work rather than merely participating in it.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes experience mostly as exposure to team activity, with little indication of personal responsibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows personal contribution to relevant work, but leaves the scope of ownership unclear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear responsibility for building or improving at least one relevant system or workflow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of relevant tooling or infrastructure from design through implementation or operation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows repeated end-to-end ownership of multiple high-leverage systems, with the applicant positioned as a principal driver of the work."}]},{"name":"Responsibility alignment","description":"How completely the letter maps the applicant's background to the specific responsibilities and technologies in the posting.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Addresses only a narrow slice of the posting and leaves major required or preferred areas unaddressed."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Covers some relevant experience, but still leaves several central responsibilities or technologies weakly connected."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects background to a meaningful portion of the posting, with a reasonable but incomplete overall match."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Maps past work to most major responsibilities and technologies named in the posting."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Provides a near point-by-point match to the posting, covering the role's technical stack, security tasks, and automation mission."}]},{"name":"Security motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why the applicant wants this security engineering role in particular.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little sense of why the applicant wants security engineering specifically."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States generic interest in security or the company without much personal rationale."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses a clear reason for pursuing the role, though the reasoning remains fairly conventional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows thoughtful personal commitment to security work, secure defaults, or protective infrastructure."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents an especially compelling and deliberate motivation that makes this role feel like a natural next step."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage mindset","description":"How well the letter shows an understanding that the role creates leverage by scaling security through internal tooling and secure defaults.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not show an understanding that the role is about scaling security through tooling used by many other engineers."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at foundational or automation work, but does not clearly connect it to broad organizational leverage."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that the role reduces manual toil or helps developers more effectively at scale."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly frames the role as internal platform work that embeds security into everyday engineering practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates a mature security-enablement philosophy centered on secure defaults, developer usability, and scaling scarce security expertise across the organization."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How consistently the letter supports claims with concrete examples, scope, and observable results.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims with little concrete detail, example, or outcome."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides a few specifics such as years, languages, or service counts, but little detail on what was achieved."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports key claims with concrete examples from work or projects."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Regularly pairs claims with specific implementations, problems solved, or outcomes produced."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds a highly credible case through precise, concrete examples and observable results throughout the letter."}]},{"name":"Supplemental security credibility","description":"How much additional security credibility the letter shows through certifications, offensive practice, or other extra-role signals.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no additional signal of hands-on security capability beyond ordinary job claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides a light signal such as occasional capture-the-flag participation or an entry-level security credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides a meaningful extra signal such as regular capture-the-flag participation, sustained hands-on practice, or a moderate certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a strong signal such as OSCP, notable capture-the-flag performance, or equivalent hands-on offensive credibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Provides multiple strong signals, such as a rigorous offensive certification combined with notable ongoing practice or performance."}]},{"name":"Self-directed initiative","description":"How much the letter shows meaningful technical initiative outside ordinary assigned work, such as open-source leadership or substantive personal projects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of technical work initiated outside normal assigned duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project or occasional extra effort, but with limited substance or continuity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows steady self-directed initiative through a maintained side project, occasional upstream patches, or similar extra work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial initiative through meaningful open-source maintenance, sustained side projects, or repeated upstream contributions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional initiative through technically ambitious projects or widely used open-source work with clear long-term ownership."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"How clear, professional, and mechanically polished the cover letter is as a piece of written communication.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, grammar, or syntax problems materially distract from the message or reduce credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Noticeable writing errors or awkward construction recur, but the overall meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Generally clear and professional writing with some minor errors or clunky phrasing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clear, well-structured, professional prose with only rare minor issues."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Highly polished, easy-to-follow writing that is both professional and stylistically confident."}]}]}
